translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Liik'o zaaruu hank'k'uwaa zarbbissee; shin poddolla k'aalay hank'k'uwaa dentsetsee.
Aad'd'eeda eranchchaa ins's'arssay eraa loytsee; shin boozatuwaa doonay boozatetsaa pulttee.
Med'inaa Godaa ayifetuu ubbasaa s'eelliino; iitaa ootsiyaawanttakka lo"uwaa ootsiyaawanttakka be'iino.
Liik'o haasayay de'uwaa mitsaa mala; shin c'imiyaa haasayay ayaanaa mentsee.
Booza Asay bare aawuwaa seeraa kad'ee; shin bare aawuwaa seeraa akkiyaa Asay c'inc'c'a.
S'illo uraa golliyaan daro miishshay de'ee; shin iitaw geliyaa miishshay metuwaa ayee.
Aad'd'eeda eranchchatuwaa doonay eraa zeree; shin boozatuwaa wozanay hewaa mala gidenna.
Med'inaa Goday iitatuwaa yarshshuwaa shenetee; shin suuretuwaa woosay Aa nashechchee.
Med'inaa Goday iita asatuwaa hemetaa shenetee; shin s'illotetsaa kaalliyaawantta I siik'ee.
Suure ogiyaa aggeeda asaa iita muruu naagee; seeraa is's'iyaa Asay hayk'k'ee.
Duufuunne bashshay Med'inaa Godaa sintsan k'onc'c'iyaan beettiino. Yaatina, asaa wozanaa k'ofay waan aappe geemmanee?
K'iliic'iyaa Asay seeriyaawaa dosenna; aad'd'eeda eranchchatuwaappekka zoriyaa oochchenna.
Wozanay nashetina, som"ii poo'ee; shin wozanay kayyotooppe, he ayaanay me"ee.
Akeekiyaa wozanay de'iyaa Asay eratetsaa koyee; shin boozatuu barenttu boozatetsan nashettiino.
Hiyyeesatuwaa de'uu ubbaa gallassikka baas'e. Shin nashetiyaa asatuu ubbaa gedekka barenttu de'uwaan aliino.
Walassay de'iyaa wolk'k'aama ak'uwaappe Med'inaa Godaa yashshatetsay de'iyaa guutsabay keeka.
Walassay de'iyaa saan mod'd'o ashuwaa maanaappe siik'uu de'iyaa saan santsaa miyaawe keeka.
Hank'k'ettiyaa Asay walassaa kessee; shin hank'k'ettanaw elleellenna Asay walassaa irs's'issee.
Azalla uraa metuu Aa ogiyaa ubbaan aguntsa dirssaa mala; shin suure uraa ogii dembbaa.
C'inc'c'a na'ay bare aawuwaa nashechchee; shin booza na'ay bare aato kad'ee.
Wozani bayinna Asay bare boozatetsan nashettee; shin wozanaama Asay likkebaa ootsee.
Zoretay d'ayooppe, halchcheeddawe polettenna; daro zoriyaawanttu de'iyaa saan halchcheeddawe polettee.
Ooshetteeddawoo likke zaaruwaa zaariyaawe he uraa nashechchee; haasayaa likke wodiyaan haasayiyaawe ayiba lo"obee!
Aad'd'eeda eranchchay bollaw kaaletsiyaa de'uwaa ogiyaan hametteeppe attina, duge duufuwaa wotsiyaa ogiyaan hamettenna.
Med'inaa Goday otoranchchatuwaa golliyaa kolana; shin am"atii zawaa naagee.
Med'inaa Goday iitatuwaa k'ofaa shenetee; shin geeshsha k'aalay Aa nashechchee.
Wordduwaan wod'iyaa demmanaw jaamiyaa Asay bare soo asaa bolla metuwaa ayee; shin mattaayiyaa is's'iyaa Asay pas'a de'ana.
S'illo Asay haasayanaappe kasetiide k'oppee; shin iitatuwaa ins's'arssay palabaa pulttee.
Med'inaa Goday iitatuwaappe haakkee; shin s'illotuwaa woosaa sisee.
Pashikkiide s'eelliyaa s'eelay wozanaa nashechchee; mishiraachchuwaa oduukka bollaa patsee.
De'uwaa immiyaa zoriyaa sisiyaa Asay aad'd'eeda eranchchatuwaana ittippe de'ana.
Seeraa is's'iyaa Asay barena k'ohee; shin seeraa akkiyaa Asay akeekaa demmee.
Med'inaa Godaw yayyiyaawe asaa aad'd'eeda eratetsaa tamaarissee; bonchchettana koyeedda Asay koyiro barena kawushshanaw koshshee.
